# Axial Skyrmions

- The reflection mechanism in this approach changes the sign of only one pion field, making the relative phase definition differ by π compared to refs.[3, 12, 7], where antiSkyrmions are created by changing signs of all three pion fields
- This definition provides a more natural comparison framework with monopole situations, offering better theoretical consistency
- The profile function reaches zero at radius s/2 from the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion center, enabling continuous patching of both configurations with vacuum fields outside their cores
- Beyond simple ansatz initial conditions (3.7), sophisticated initial conditions were implemented using the rational map ansatz [11] with axially symmetric charge n mapping
